mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 71 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. Please note the air quality is currently moderate with an index of 56, and we are under a Waning Crescent moon tonight.

In city news, the Plan Commission is reviewing upcoming development projects including the site plan for 201 South Main Street. Additionally, while voting for the new I Voted sticker contest has concluded, we look forward to seeing the winning student designs in the November election.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the fun continues with Farmer's Market festivities at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia options at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on August 6, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to the arrest of a 49-year-old man for his fourth O W I offence.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open at 10 AM.
